parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy task
parameters.name: strategy_task_name

parameters.example: 漏洞自动化批量修复策略
parameters.help_en: The Policy Name. Set the value to Automated Batch Vulnerability Fix Policy
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。固定取值：漏洞自动化批量修复策略
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en:
The parameter settings of the policy. The value is a character string in JSON array format. Details:

Vulnerability configuration item. Values:
name: vluList
associationProperty: sasAllVul
value: the basic information about the vulnerability

Snapshot configuration item. Values:
name: snapshotConfig
associationProperty: snapshotConfig
value: the storage duration information

Notification configuration:
name: notifyConfig
associationProperty: notifyConfig
value: the configuration information about email or DingTalk

The vulList child configuration item is required, and the JSON array must contain an entry whose name is vulList. The snapshotConfig and notifyConfig child configuration items are optional
parameters.help_zh:
策略的参数信息。JSONArray格式的字符串，含义：

漏洞配置项。取值：
name：vluList
associationProperty：sasAllVul
value：漏洞的基本信息

快照配置项。取值
name：snapshotConfig
associationProperty：snapshotConfig
value：存储时间信息

通知配置
name：notifyConfig
associationProperty：notifyConfig
value：邮件或者钉钉的配置信息

vulList 为必填子配置项，JSON 数组中必须包含 name 为 vulList 的条目；snapshotConfig 和 notifyConfig 为可选子配置项
